title: The first confirmed planet around a Sun-like star had a 4-day year
body: The 1995 discovery of 51 Pegasi b revealed a gas giant about half Jupiter's mass circling a Sun-like star every 4.2 days. It orbits much closer to its star than Mercury does to the Sun.
takeaway: Other systems can put giant planets in places our Solar System would never lead us to expect.
source: NASA Science, 51 Pegasi b and Nobel Winners Changed Our Understanding
visual: a giant planet passing very close to a glowing star

title: NASA brought back 121.6 grams of asteroid Bennu
body: OSIRIS-REx collected rocks and dust from Bennu's surface on 20 October 2020. The sample capsule returned to Earth in 2023, and NASA measured a total of 121.6 grams of asteroid material.
takeaway: Bringing a sample home lets future instruments ask questions that the spacecraft could never have tested.
source: NASA Science, OSIRIS-REx Frequently Asked Questions
visual: a tray of small dark asteroid fragments under a laboratory lamp
